ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 55:45 distribution of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal lobes feature contiguous high-intensity white pigmentation. A central, low-intensity black wedge extends from the peduncle to the trailing edge. Multiple dark linear streaks are mapped diagonally across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximate angle of 45 degrees; vertical depth occupies roughly 12% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations; approximately 12-15 distinct peaks per lobe; amplitude varies between 5 and 25 pixels, with most pronounced jaggedness on the distal third of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve; concave profile adjacent to the median notch transitioning to a convex curve along the mid-lobe and terminating in an upward-curved tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters detected at the superior margins and distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral fields on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue notches along the trailing edge, particularly a large indentation on the inner left lobe and minor chipping at the distal right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine-grained dark speckling and mottling observed at the boundary interface between the central black pigmentation and the white distal regions.
